item.title: US soldiers who died during Iran conflict remembered as devoted parents, reservists

item.title: GasBuddy’s Matt McClain says Valley gas prices could go up 20 to 55 cents in next week
item.description: GasBuddy petroleum analyst Matt McClain said Tuesday that gas prices in the Valley could increase significantly within the next week following U.S. military strikes in Iran.

item.title: Tucson man indicted for shooting at Border Patrol agent in January
item.description: A 34-year-old Tucson man was indicted last week for allegedly trying to murder a U.S. Border Patrol agent in late January.

item.title: Haitian man dies from tooth infection while detained in Florence ICE facility, report says
item.description: A Haitian man who was being detained by ICE in Florence is dead after a tooth infection was reportedly not given "timely medical care."
